fields.name: Parent_Account_Description
fields.fieldText:
Reminder: You have access to update most fields on Accounts.

 

Team, we heard loud and clear that you wanted more control over Account information without needing to file tickets. To support this, we have granted you access to edit most fields on your accounts.

 

What to Expect:

You can update most account fields in Salesforce. Any field that you are not allowed to access is locked down. Some examples are TDLINX ID, MSA ID, and Account Owner. Record Type will require utilizing the Change Record Type function. The data management request feature has been updated to remove the selections for the newly updated access that you have.

 

Desktop:

On desktop, click on the pencil icon next to each field.

 

Mobile:

On mobile, select the following:  

  • “More” button indicated by 3 dots in the top right of the account page.
  • “Edit” from the options contained in the menu window.
  • Update items within edit window.
  • “Save” in the top right corner of the edit window once changes are complete.

To reflect changes, flick down from the middle of the account record.

 

If you are unable to update address information, Chatter @Hunter Brown after first confirming with relevant stakeholders (e.g. RAM/KAM).

fields.name: RoutingErrorLocationMessage
fields.fieldText:
Routing Errors need to be corrected within the Maps App


Updating Verified Location: Instructions.

  • Plot a Marker layer on the Map.
  • Click the incorrectly placed Marker.
  • Select the menu next to “Add to Schedule” (aka “Actions Tab”) indicated by three dots

  • Scroll down within that menu and select “Set Verified Location.”

  • Once the marker turns transparent, tap and drag to the correct location.

What to Expect: 

  • Once you move the marker, Salesforce Maps stores the latitude and longitude fields directly from the map to the Verified Latitude and Verified Longitude fields you created. 
  • When Salesforce Maps plots this record again, it will use the Verified Latitude and Verified Longitude fields to plot the marker where you specified.

Reference Material: Use Set Verified Location in Maps (link)

fields.name: MissingSalesforceAccount
fields.fieldText:
Adding Missing Salesforce Account:

Below are the steps to take if you cannot locate a new, missing account in Salesforce, that has active MSA depletions.


Steps:  

-First, search for a missing account using name or address (be mindful that street names may be spelled in several different ways).

-If an account cannot be found by searching for that record, and you are certain that the account has ordered from a reporting wholesaler for at least 1 month minimum, email James Martin (james.martin@juul.com). Include store name, address, reporting wholesaler name, wholesaler customer number (if available), and your ask.

fields.name: SubTypeUpdateAccountDescription
fields.fieldText:
Update: Updating Record Type is now handled through the “Change Record Type” function.

 

This feature is available through the drop-down menu in the top right of the account record page (desktop) or the “More” menu in the top right of the account record page (mobile).

 

What to Expect: Utilizing the “Change Record Type” function will only change the record type. 


Updating to Chain: Once “Change Record Type” has been completed, you will need to edit the “Type” from the account landing page, and select “Regional Chain” or “National Chain.” 

 

Best Practices:

-Update account-level details once “Change Record Type” is complete (e.g. Account Name, Does Business As, Parent Account, Juul Channel, and Juul Sub Channel).

-Consult with Field Sales Director for Segment changes (FSD maintains permissions to make those changes). 

-If updating from independent to chain: Chatter account manager to request account is parented appropriately, associated with the correct HQ, and that Account Name and Does Business As are aligned with naming conventions for that chain.

-If updating from chain to independent: Chatter account manager to confirm store has been divested and that account has been detached from hierarchy. Then, complete Change Record Type.

-If updating to sub-distributor: Consult with manager for Segment and Ownership changes. FSDs reserve the right to change ownership to align with the owner of the master wholesaler servicing that account.

fields.fieldText:
Updating Primary Distributor

Primary distributor is updated weekly within the Tableau Account Intelligence Dashboard (aka Tableau links at the top of an account page). 


This information is populated via an automated formula based on whichever distributor shipped the store the most JUUL product in the past 13 weeks. Primary Distributor information cannot be updated.
